W.calibration: Frontal west-elevation proxy. Modern west photographs have no usable camera position in the downloaded metadata; elevation fit is approximate, not an exact photo solve.

S.camera_height_basis: 1.7 m above nominal project grade is an eye-level approximation; absolute EXIF altitude cannot be transferred without a verified church-ground elevation.
S.sensor_width_basis: M05 is a 2464x3696 portrait image with 30 mm full-frame-equivalent focal length recorded in Commons metadata. The active horizontal 35-mm-equivalent width is approximately 23.4 mm for this 2:3 format; the source dimensions determine the portrait framing.
S.local_position_basis: M05 GPS converts to approximately [-35.1, -36.3, 1.7] m from the inferred crossing anchor in data/coordinate_system.yaml; GPS location and recorded 30 mm equivalent focal length are retained. M05 has no heading, so target [0, -10, 18] m is an inferred visual fit selected after testing z=16, 18, 20 and 23 m: z=18 gives the best joint placement of the turret, conch roof peak and facade base among these candidates. It is not a solved camera pose. Diagnostic poses 4 m and 8 m toward the model with a z=15 m target crop the near south elevation and are rejected. The separate M04 GPS photo remains unresolved: its converted camera point falls inside the coarse south-conch mass and available offset diagnostics fail.

M21.heading_basis: Commons file-page Location template records cardinal NW; 315 degrees is only the nominal center, not a degree-level camera bearing.
M21.camera_height_basis: 1.7 m above nominal project grade is an eye-level approximation; Commons does not provide camera altitude usable as project Z.
M21.sensor_width_basis: The Commons image is 3344x4770 from a Canon EOS 550D with 29 mm recorded focal length. Canon specifies a 22.3x14.9 mm sensor; the portrait image's short sensor dimension adjusted by 3344/3456 gives an approximate 14.42 mm active width. The crop/sensor fit is inferred.
M21.local_position_basis: Commons camera coordinates converted into local east/north using the approximate crossing anchor in data/coordinate_system.yaml. The source records cardinal NW (315 degrees nominal only). The saved target uses a 32 m inferred horizontal distance with z=17 m; local camera height, target distance, height and pitch are visual-fit inferences, not supplied metadata.

SE.camera_height_basis: 1.7 m above nominal project grade is an eye-level approximation; absolute EXIF altitude cannot be transferred without a verified church-ground elevation.
SE.sensor_width_basis: M02 is a 3696x3053 crop from a Nikon D5100 (APS-C), with 27 mm full-frame-equivalent focal length. The 1.21 image aspect uses an active horizontal 35-mm-equivalent width of approximately 23.4 mm x 3696/3053 = 28.3 mm. This models the saved crop without inventing camera metadata.
SE.local_position_basis: GPS converted using the inferred approximate crossing coordinate in data/coordinate_system.yaml. M02 has no heading. After correcting the active sensor width to match the 3696x3053 crop, direct comparison showed the tower pair and roof turret still left of their source positions; diagnostic re-aims toward [-15, 0, 25] shifted them toward the source without changing GPS location or focal length. The iteration-6 candidate target [-15, 0, 29] also moves the model down slightly to match the photo's near-full-height framing. This is a camera-fit inference only; the roof/conch silhouette residual remains open.

N.calibration: Orthographic north-elevation proxy from the modern north views; exact camera pose is unavailable.

E.calibration: Orthographic historic east-elevation proxy. No modern direct-east photograph is present in the curated dataset.

NE.calibration: Raised northeast geometry-reference view only; camera pose is approximate because the source set has no matching solved-camera metadata.

TOP.calibration: Top-down plan check; M01 is an oblique aerial and is used for roof geometry only, not as a camera solve.

M18.camera_height_basis: 1.7 m above nominal project grade is an eye-level approximation; Commons provides no camera altitude usable as project Z.
M18.sensor_width_basis: M18 EXIF records a Canon EOS 550D and a 24 mm focal length. The camera manual gives a 22.3 x 14.9 mm sensor; the source image aspect is 5209/3367. A 22.3 mm active horizontal sensor width is used, while any crop history remains unknown.
M18.local_position_basis: Commons file-page Location template coordinates are used as the image camera position and converted to local east/north using the approximate crossing anchor. The same coordinates occur on M21, photographed at the same session. The page stores only cardinal NW; its 315-degree center is not an exact heading. A 330-degree bearing, 32 m aim distance, camera height and target z=32 m are inferred from M18 landmark ordering and candidate renders, not source measurements.
